$comment: Reviewed list of tracked, non-test, non-generated TS files under packages/{core,app,mcp,engine} that contain document logic (create/mutate/validate/serialize the .vcad document: parts, nodes, roots, materials, params, undo, command execution, IR building). partial:true = only part of the file is document logic; the whole file is still counted. Changes to this list are reviewed in PRs. Run via `npm run doc-logic:loc`.

files.reason: Zustand document store: CRDT-backed parts/nodes/roots/materials/undo/redo mutations
Sends DocCommand to the Rust document engine; command envelope and error handling
Document parameters/bindings held outside the CRDT and merged into the IR before evaluation
CRDT parameter value constructors used by the mutation path
Chat tool execution: every mutation goes through the engine (applyTool); remaining TS is read/inspect/describe/search tools and display summaries
Applies Rust ToolOutcome directly to a plain Document IR (MCP session path)
Stable part-id assignment and lazy migration stored in Document.partIds
Tool registry: plans chat tool calls via WASM, mirrors ToolOutcome; also schema/prompt building
Serialization/deserialization of .vcad files (CRDT bytes, legacy IR migration)
Translates sketch constraints into persisted document-level DesignConstraints
TS evaluator that walks the IR DAG and builds geometry from document nodes
DAG child/dependency extraction over IR CsgOps
Dispatches registry tool calls and applies outcomes to session documents
Batched document edits with atomic apply/rollback
Adds/solves/checks persisted design constraints on the document
In-memory document session map: create, lookup, per-user scope
Document session lifecycle: open/get/close/save/load/persist
list/set parameters mutate Document.parameters; sensitivity/gradient are kernel calls
Document snapshot/restore and branching
Resumes a document from a continuation token
Validates design constraints and maps them to receipt claims
Creates/evaluates documents from loon source and records provenance
Tracks loon-source provenance and divergence on the document
STEP import that inserts nodes/roots into the session document
URDF import that builds parts, nodes and joints in the document (includes STL parsing)
create_sheet_metal builds the IR node chain; the other tools are kernel calls
Inserts the optimized mesh as a part and edits roots; solve is a kernel call
place_part inserts library part instances into the document; search is a facade
Joint ordering/validation over Document.joints
Joint-state schema and pose application to the document
Persistence/serialization layer for session documents
Persisted loon macro definitions used to author documents
App-level save/serialize of the document to .vcad text
IndexedDB persistence of serialized documents and edit locks
Migrates legacy stored documents to the canonical CRDT format
Opens a stored document: flush, engine swap, document meta
Decodes/loads documents from URL and share links
Chat tools that read/rename the document
Runs MCP handlers on a document clone and routes mutations back via import_ir
Autosave pipeline: serialize and persist the document
Executes chat tool calls against the document store
Restores chat-created document state on load
Merges parameters into the document and drives evaluation
Applies/broadcasts CRDT ops between collaborators
Viewport tool handlers that create/modify parts via the store (mostly UI)
Document version history, restore and merge into the live document

excluded.reason: PCB/ECAD tools (excluded by policy); likewise engine/src/ecad.ts, core/src/stores/electronics-store.ts, core/src/utils/receipt/*, mcp tools import-pcb.ts and pcb-*.ts
Generated IR types, not under counted packages
Engine class: kernel-call wrappers; bakeStepImports is the only document rewrite and is small
Thin kernel/WASM facades or render caches holding no document logic
Thin wrapper over the Rust loon serializer
View, session or editor-interaction state, not .vcad document state
Example document fixtures (data, no logic); materials.ts is a catalog
